notes.title: Deadvale Full Story Demo Now Playable!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Previously we released a large section of the Deadvale story demo, but we had much more planned than just the initial Shore zone that was made available last month, and now we're finally ready to show the full demo![/p][p][/p][p]Check out the teaser and trailer here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDpxMk7T1xg"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1LcE359hQHQ"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]At long last, the entire demo as we originally intended it is now released and fully playable, featuring a new interior Library zone and much more content to delve into.[/p][p][/p][p]In the Library, we've made more explicit use of the physics system in gameplay, something that was not explored much in the Shore zone, although what you see in the Library is still but a taste of what we have planned in the final game. In order to focus the demo specifically on building up and introducing Deadvale's story, we've limited a lot of what is shown in the demo to be a more constrained, curated and linear experience than what future levels in the final game will be like.[/p][p][/p][p]While the demo is linear with some slight diversions, rest assured, the final game will have a more open feel. Our plan is not to build a fully open world, but not a fully linear one either.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, I hope you enjoy the now-complete demo, and please don't hesitate to leave feedback, it is always appreciated (positive or negative). Cheers![/p][p]-Juggernaute[/p][p][/p][p]TikTok: [/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@deadvale_game"]https://www.tiktok.com/@deadvale_game[/url][/p][p][/p][p]YouTube: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@juggernaute7034"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/3ehJ4SHwnV"]https://discord.com/invite/3ehJ4SHwnV[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Deadvale Story Demo Now on Steam
notes.content: [p]​Hello everyone,[/p][p]We have been hard at work building a new story demo for Deadvale that brings much more detailed narrative and immersion to the game. If you've played previous demos, there are a few small similarities, but not to worry, it should be a very new experience. We've created a completely new story and added much more environment detail.[/p][p][/p][p]Julius continues to compose excellent music for the game which truly hearkens back to the good old CRPGs of the 90's and early 2000's. He has mastered the craft of (Jeremy) Soules-like music, hope you'll pardon the pun! Check out his channel: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@JuliusRimkevicius"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]​​Katie has done a phenomenal job bringing Deadvale's narrator to life, and also has the honor of being the first voice in the game! Check out her website and prior work: [/p][p][url="https://www.katieotten.com/"]https://www.katieotten.com/[/url][/p][p]​​[/p][p]Jason has taken the skeleton of a plot we'd had before and written a fantastic story structure and narrative outline for the entire game, as well as a detailed script for the intro that is now available to download here on itch.io and Steam. Check out his prior work: [/p][p][url="https://ace-jace.itch.io/"]https://ace-jace.itch.io/[/url][/p][p]​[/p][p]William has joined the fledgling team as well, and without doubt his incredible voice will ignite future characters in the game. More on that coming soon! Check out his website and prior work: [/p][p][url="https://www.castingcall.club/WilliamCancel"]https://www.castingcall.club/WilliamCancel[/url][/p][p]​[/p][p]Jon has begun creating concept art and sketches of the characters and world of Deadvale. Very excited to see his work in future releases of the game! Check out his website: [/p][p][url="https://www.jonathandouglasscollins.art/"]https://www.jonathandouglasscollins.art/[/url][/p][p]​[/p][p]Jojo has offered his unique range and ability to sound like thirty different people toward the project, which will undoubtedly come very much in handy soon! His experience contributing to the Skywind project will certainly be valuable: [/p][p][url="https://tesrskywind.com/"]https://tesrskywind.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]As always, I hope you enjoy the demo, and please don't hesitate to leave feedback, it is always appreciated (positive or negative). Cheers![/p][p]-Juggernaute[/p][p][/p][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@deadvale_game"]https://www.tiktok.com/@deadvale_game[/url][/p][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@juggernaute7034"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/3ehJ4SHwnV"]https://discord.com/invite/3ehJ4SHwnV[/url][/p]
